title: Banach spaces of continuous paths with finite $p$-th variation
summary: We study pathwise $p$-th variation of continuous paths on a compact interval along a fixed partition sequence. Although the class of continuous paths with finite $p$-th variation is generally not linear, we develop a coefficient-based approach via Faber-Schauder expansions that, for any $p>1$, enables the construction of paths with prescribed $p$-th variation while preserving useful linear structures and Hölder regularity.
